description: Return headline facts from the Fox Davidson Lending Index, a quarterly note on UK bridging, commercial and development lending drawn from Fox Davidson completed deals: median days to complete a regulated bridge, typical loan sizes and loan to value, owner-occupier share of commercial mortgages, and current lending trends, with findings that can be quoted with credit. From Fox Davidson, whole of market UK mortgage brokers authorised and regulated by the FCA (FRN 1056214).
